impact: A China EV relief rally rather than a portfolio driver; no direct read-through to Clement's holdings beyond a modest lift to China tech sentiment.
summary: Li Auto's Q3 2026 net loss narrowed to RMB309.7 million (US$46.2M) from RMB624.4 million a year earlier, well better than the roughly RMB942 million consensus loss. Revenue was RMB28.8 billion on 99,964 deliveries with a 16.7% gross margin; Unusual Whales flagged the stock closing up 11.0%.
title: Li Auto Q3 loss narrows to RMB309.7M, beats; stock closes up 11%
